Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Urgent: Production latency spikes impacting checkout flows

Team —

We're seeing a sharp regression on our Redwood integration starting ~08:45 PST. Checkout P95 latency jumped from ~120ms to ~1.6s, error rate rose to ~4% on token-generation endpoints, and throughput fell ~35%. Our customers are seeing timeouts on payment confirmation pages.

Attached a short sample of error traces and timestamps (error-samples.log). Key notes:
- Spike started 08:45–08:50 and persisted for ~30 minutes before partial recovery.
- Affected region: us-west (production cluster w/ routing through hosted API).
- This directly impacts our processing window for peak traffic (07:30–09:30 PST).

We need immediate coordination. Please confirm an on-call war-room and an exec contact for our CPO.

Thanks,
Michael Tucker
Head of Platform — Auriga Labs

Please join the bridge if available, otherwise we'll keep you posted.

Subject: Re: [Bridge] Auriga Labs — War-room notes & action log (10:00 PST)

Status update and technical summary:

What we found:
- Root cause: a scheduler heuristic change (autotune for batching window) deployed in yesterday's release increased batching latency for short-interaction requests when burst patterns present. The heuristic misclassified Auriga's checkout tokenization shape and introduced head-of-line waits.
- Evidence: request replay shows a 4.1x median wait increase at 08:47 for generation requests matching Auriga's token profile. See attached rollout-checksum.txt and qps-graph.png.

Mitigation executed:
- 10:12: rolled partial rollback on scheduler across primary host pool.
- 10:30–11:00: promoted rollback to full affected pool; flush KV cache for pinned routes; added 12 worker processes to handle backlog.

Impact now:
- Throughput back to ~92% of baseline for Auriga route.
- Error rate down from 4% to 0.6% over last 2 hours.
- P95 latency reduced to ~220ms (from the 1.6s peak).

Next steps:
1) Postmortem timeline: full RCA doc due in 48 hours; interim RCA notes (high-level) by tomorrow EOD.
2) Engineering action: add an automated test on batching heuristics for short-burst workloads and add a rollback safety gate to the deployment pipeline.
3) Commercial: finalize SLA credit calc (Laura) and a customer goodwill package.

Attachments: rollout-checksum.txt; qps-graph.png

Dylan Brooks
Senior SRE, Serving Runtime

Team / Board,

Short executive summary (for external comms and CEO update):
- Incident window: 08:45–11:05 PST (primary impact 08:45–10:15).
- Impact: transient P95 latency spike up to 1.6s, error rate peaked at 4% for token-generation endpoints; throughput reduced ~35% during peak.
- Root cause: a batching-scheduler heuristic change deployed in last night's release that increased head-of-line latency for short-burst tokenization workloads.
- Mitigation: rollback of scheduler heuristic (10:12–11:00), KV cache flush, increased worker processes. Customer route now at ~92% throughput and p95 ~220ms. Error rate stabilized <1%.

Customer status: Michael/Priya confirmed that the customer-facing checkout flows are recovering; Auriga is satisfied with the technical fix and will wait for the postmortem and credit proposal. They requested a single-page incident timeline and talking points for their CTO call tomorrow.

Next actions (owners & ETA):
- Incident RCA doc (engineering): 48 hours (Dylan & Marcus).
- Interim executive one-pager & talking points for Auriga (Evelyn): by 09:30 PST tomorrow.
- SLA credit estimate & approval path (Laura): by 12:30 PST tomorrow.
- Deployment safety gate & test (Marissa): policy proposal in 72 hours.

Recommended customer comms: express apology, summarize root cause clearly (no jargon), confirm concrete changes (rollback, test, safety gate), offer a goodwill credit for the impacted window, and offer a technical sync to walk through the RCA.

I'll draft the one-pager and talking points and share a link to the drive once ready. Please add any high-level notes or risks to the thread.
